blocks.text: LINGAYEN, Pangasinan — Police seized an estimated P4.9 million worth of suspected marijuana products and arrested an 18-year-old suspect from Bacnotan, La Union. This happened during a buy-bust operation in Urdaneta City on Friday, Oct. 2. The suspect, who is jobless and temporarily residing in Urdaneta City, was also found in possession of an unregistered firearm and ammunition, police said. The operation yielded 27,730 grams of suspected dried marijuana leaves, 511 grams of suspected marijuana kush and 240 milliliters of suspected liquid marijuana, with a combined standard drug price of P4,913,400.
